blocks.zh: Section 6 Appendix I: AEX Reprocessing Case Study 附錄一:陰離子交換層析再處理案例
blocks.en: Section 6 Appendix I: AEX Reprocessing Case Study

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
理解 Anion Exchange Chromatography (AEX, 陰離子交換層析) 作為 mAb 純化平台工具的單元操作特性，以及其在 HCP、DNA 清除上的關鍵角色。
blocks.en: Understand the unit operation characteristics of Anion Exchange Chromatography (AEX) as a platform tool in mAb purification, and its key role in clearing HCP and DNA.

blocks.zh: 掌握 6.2 Points to Consider（考量要點）：Column Packing、Cleaning/Sanitization、Performance、Regeneration/Lifecycle、Validation/Filings 五個評估維度，判斷再處理的技術可行性。
blocks.en: Master the five evaluation dimensions of 6.2 Points to Consider (Column Packing, Cleaning/Sanitization, Performance, Regeneration/Lifecycle, Validation/Filings) to judge the technical feasibility of reprocessing.

blocks.zh: 運用 FMEA（Failure Mode and Effects Analysis, 失效模式與影響分析）工具，以 RPN = Severity × Occurrence × Detection 系統性評分，識別 AEX 步驟為最高風險候選再處理步驟（RPN = 125）。
blocks.en: Apply FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) with a systematic RPN = Severity × Occurrence × Detection score to identify the AEX step as the highest-risk candidate for reprocessing (RPN = 125).

blocks.zh: 建立再處理的商業決策框架（Option 1 廢棄批次 vs Option 2 重新設計 vs Option 3 再處理），理解 Option 3 在品質與成本之間的平衡邏輯。
blocks.en: Build a business decision framework for reprocessing (Option 1 discard the batch vs Option 2 redesign vs Option 3 reprocess), and understand the logic by which Option 3 balances quality and cost.

blocks.zh: 熟悉 6.4 Quality Considerations 中的可比性標準（Comparability Criteria）、分析方法矩陣（Analytical Methods）及監控觸發點（Monitor Triggers），作為再處理決策的品質把關依據。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the Comparability Criteria, the Analytical Methods matrix and the Monitor Triggers in 6.4 Quality Considerations, which serve as the quality safeguards for reprocessing decisions.

blocks.zh: 6.0 Appendix I: Hypothetical Case Study (Reprocessing Framework) — Anion Exchange Chromatography 附錄一：假設性案例研究（再處理框架）— 陰離子交換層析
blocks.en: 6.0 Appendix I: Hypothetical Case Study (Reprocessing Framework) — Anion Exchange Chromatography

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
核心概念解析 Key Concepts
Reprocessing（再處理）：將不符合中間品 (intermediate) 規格的批次，在相同製程步驟重新處理一次，以達到可接受的品質標準。與 Reworking（重新加工，改用不同方法）不同。
blocks.en: Reprocessing: Reprocessing a batch that does not meet intermediate specifications by running it through the same process step once more, in order to reach an acceptable quality standard. This differs from reworking, which uses a different method.

blocks.zh: AEX（Anion Exchange Chromatography，陰離子交換層析）：利用蛋白質表面負電荷與陽性樹脂之間的靜電作用進行分離。mAb 在 flow-through 模式下直接通過，而 HCP（Host Cell Proteins，宿主細胞蛋白）、DNA、內毒素、病毒等帶負電雜質則吸附於樹脂上被清除。
blocks.en: AEX (Anion Exchange Chromatography): Separation based on the electrostatic interaction between negative charges on the protein surface and the positively charged resin. In flow-through mode the mAb passes straight through, while negatively charged impurities such as HCP (host cell proteins), DNA, endotoxin and viruses bind to the resin and are removed.

blocks.zh: A-Mab Case Study：業界標竿性的假設性 mAb 生產案例，由多家公司聯合撰寫，廣泛用於 CMC 開發框架示範。TR74 借用此框架設計 AEX 再處理情境。
blocks.en: A-Mab Case Study: An industry benchmark hypothetical mAb manufacturing case, co-authored by several companies and widely used to demonstrate CMC development frameworks. TR74 borrows this framework to design the AEX reprocessing scenario.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
AEX 再處理就像工廠品管員在出貨前發現某批零件表面殘留油污超標（相當於 HCP 超標），不是直接廢棄這批零件，而是把整批零件再送一次清洗線重新清洗。但這麼做必須先確認：清洗設備還在規格範圍內嗎？清洗次數有沒有超過驗證上限？清洗後零件品質不會變差？——這就是 6.2 Points to Consider 要回答的問題。
blocks.en: AEX reprocessing is like a factory QC inspector who finds, before shipment, that the surface oil residue on a lot of parts exceeds the limit (equivalent to excess HCP). Instead of scrapping the whole lot, the inspector sends it through the cleaning line one more time. But first several things must be confirmed: Is the cleaning equipment still within specification? Has the number of cleaning cycles exceeded the validated limit? Will the cleaning make the parts any worse? These are exactly the questions that 6.2 Points to Consider is meant to answer.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
TR74 刻意選擇 AEX 作為示範案例，因為它比「重新過濾」（Section 7.0 refiltration）更複雜：涉及樹脂壽命、柱床完整性、病毒清除驗證等多個面向。熟悉本節後，處理較簡單的再處理步驟時只需套用其子集即可。
blocks.en: TR74 deliberately chose AEX as the demonstration case because it is more complex than "refiltration" (Section 7.0 refiltration): it involves resin lifetime, column bed integrity, viral clearance validation and other aspects. Once you are familiar with this section, you only need to apply a subset of it to simpler reprocessing steps.

blocks.zh: 決策層級提醒：品質管理系統與法規要求永遠優先於商業考量。
blocks.en: Reminder on the hierarchy of decisions: the quality management system and regulatory requirements always take precedence over business considerations.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
AEX 是 flow-through 模式還是 bind-and-elute 模式？這對再處理設計有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Is AEX a flow-through mode or a bind-and-elute mode? What does this mean for reprocessing design?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR74 要用「假設性」案例（hypothetical case study）而非真實批次資料？
blocks.en: Why does TR74 use a "hypothetical" case study rather than real batch data?

blocks.zh: 6.1 Unit Operation Characteristics 單元操作特性
四大層析原理（見 Table 6.1-1）：
電荷（Charge）→ IEX：AEX（陰離子交換）、CEX（陽離子交換）
大小（Size）→ SEC：Size Exclusion Chromatography，用於聚集體分析
blocks.en: Size → SEC: Size Exclusion Chromatography, used for aggregate analysis

blocks.zh: 疏水性（Hydrophobicity）→ HIC / RPC：Hydrophobic Interaction / Reversed Phase Chromatography
blocks.en: Hydrophobicity → HIC / RPC: Hydrophobic Interaction / Reversed Phase Chromatography

blocks.zh: 生物辨識（Biorecognition）→ Affinity：Protein A 親和層析為 mAb 第一步純化主力
blocks.en: Biorecognition → Affinity: Protein A affinity chromatography is the workhorse first purification step for mAbs

blocks.zh: Flow-Through Mode（流穿模式）：AEX 通常以 flow-through 操作。mAb 在目標 pH/conductivity 下帶正電或中性，不與陰離子樹脂結合，直接流過；而 HCP、DNA、內毒素帶負電，吸附於樹脂，藉此清除雜質。這與 Protein A（bind-and-elute 模式）截然不同。
blocks.en: Flow-Through Mode: AEX is usually operated in flow-through mode. At the target pH/conductivity the mAb is positively charged or neutral, does not bind to the anion resin and flows straight through, whereas HCP, DNA and endotoxin are negatively charged and bind to the resin, which removes these impurities. This is quite different from Protein A (bind-and-elute mode).

blocks.zh: Table 6.1-2 關鍵品質屬性（CQA）標記（*）：Aggregation、Galactose content、Afucosylation、High mannose content、Nonglycosylated heavy chain、Sialic acid content、Host-cell proteins (HCP)、DNA 均被標記為 CQA。再處理設計必須證明對這些 CQA 無不良影響，這是監管機關的核心關注點。
blocks.en: Table 6.1-2 Critical quality attributes (CQA) marked with (*): Aggregation, Galactose content, Afucosylation, High mannose content, Nonglycosylated heavy chain, Sialic acid content, Host-cell proteins (HCP) and DNA are all marked as CQAs. The reprocessing design must demonstrate no adverse effect on these CQAs, which is a core concern of regulators.

blocks.zh: DS（Drug Substance，原料藥）層次：本案例為 DS/上游純化流程，與 DP（Drug Product，製劑）的無菌充填不同，但相同的品質風險管理邏輯適用。CDMO 在與 Sponsor 或 DS CMO 討論時，此框架提供共同語言。
blocks.en: DS (Drug Substance) level: This case concerns the DS/upstream purification process, which differs from aseptic filling of the DP (Drug Product), but the same quality risk management logic applies. When a CDMO discusses with a Sponsor or DS CMO, this framework provides a common language.

blocks.zh: 把層析柱想像成濾水器的濾芯，不同濾芯設計攔截不同種類的雜質（依大小、電荷、疏水性或特異性識別）。AEX 的 flow-through 模式就像用帶負電的濾網：帶負電的雜質（HCP、DNA）會被吸住，而目標蛋白（mAb）帶正電，直接通過濾網，達到純化目的。
blocks.en: Think of the chromatography column as the cartridge in a water filter: different cartridge designs capture different kinds of impurities (by size, charge, hydrophobicity or specific recognition). The AEX flow-through mode is like using a negatively charged screen: negatively charged impurities (HCP, DNA) are held back, while the target protein (mAb), which is positively charged, passes straight through the screen, achieving purification.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
對於 Fill-Finish CDMO 而言，雖然 AEX 屬於 DS 端製程，但在 Tech Transfer 審查 DS CMO 的 Manufacturing Process Description（Section 3.2.S.2.2）時，了解 AEX 的 flow-through 原理與 HCP 清除機制，有助於評估 Sponsor 提供的 CQA 合理性及批次放行規格的風險等級。
blocks.en: For a Fill-Finish CDMO, although AEX belongs to the DS side of the process, when reviewing the DS CMO's Manufacturing Process Description (Section 3.2.S.2.2) during tech transfer, understanding the AEX flow-through principle and the HCP clearance mechanism helps assess the plausibility of the CQAs provided by the Sponsor and the risk level of the batch release specifications.

blocks.zh: AEX 在 flow-through 模式下，若進料溶液的 pH 或電導率（conductivity）超出設定範圍，HCP 清除效果會如何改變？
blocks.en: In AEX flow-through mode, how does HCP clearance change if the pH or conductivity of the load solution falls outside the set range?

blocks.zh: Table 6.1-2 中，哪些 CQA 與 AEX 步驟最直接相關？為什麼 HCP 和 DNA 被列為 CQA？
blocks.en: In Table 6.1-2, which CQAs are most directly related to the AEX step? Why are HCP and DNA listed as CQAs?

blocks.zh: 6.2 Points to Consider 考量要點
6.2.1 Column Packing 柱填充
6.2.2 Cleaning and Sanitization 清洗與消毒
6.2.3 Performance 操作性能
6.2.4 Regeneration and Lifecycle 再生與生命週期
6.2.5 Validation and Filings 驗證與法規申報
五大考量要點（6.2.1–6.2.5）決定再處理技術可行性：
blocks.en: Five points to consider (6.2.1–6.2.5) determine the technical feasibility of reprocessing:

blocks.zh: 6.2.1 Column Packing（柱填充）：再處理前必須重新確認柱床（column bed）完整性。常用指標：HETP（Height Equivalent to Theoretical Plate，理論板高當量）、Asymmetry（不對稱因子）、transition analysis（轉換分析）。柱床若出現裂縫或通道，再處理毫無意義。
blocks.en: 6.2.1 Column Packing: Column bed integrity must be reconfirmed before reprocessing. Common indicators are HETP (Height Equivalent to a Theoretical Plate), asymmetry and transition analysis. If the bed shows cracks or channeling, reprocessing is pointless.

blocks.zh: 6.2.2 Cleaning/Sanitization（清洗/消毒）：NaOH（sodium hydroxide，氫氧化鈉）是最常用的樹脂 sanitization 試劑；清洗 SOP 必須完整執行，不能因「趕時間再處理」而縮短。
blocks.en: 6.2.2 Cleaning/Sanitization: NaOH (sodium hydroxide) is the most commonly used resin sanitization reagent; the cleaning SOP must be executed in full and must not be shortened because of "hurrying to reprocess".

blocks.zh: 6.2.3 Performance（性能）：柱效測試不只看外觀，必須符合預定接受標準。
blocks.en: 6.2.3 Performance: Column efficiency testing must not rest on appearance alone; the column must meet the predefined acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 6.2.4 Regeneration/Lifecycle（再生/生命週期）：再處理使用次數必須計入已驗證的樹脂壽命（resin lifetime）。若再處理導致超過驗證使用次數，需額外驗證延壽。
blocks.en: 6.2.4 Regeneration/Lifecycle: The number of uses for reprocessing must be counted toward the validated resin lifetime. If reprocessing causes the validated number of uses to be exceeded, additional validation is needed to extend the lifetime.

blocks.zh: 6.2.5 Validation/Filings（驗證/申報）：再處理本身是一個製程變更，需要驗證並依 CTD 結構提交。FDA（美國）對應 CBE-30/PAS；EMA（歐盟）對應 Type IB/Type II Variation。
blocks.en: 6.2.5 Validation/Filings: Reprocessing is itself a process change; it must be validated and submitted in the CTD structure. For the FDA (US) this corresponds to CBE-30/PAS; for the EMA (EU), to a Type IB/Type II Variation.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula

HETP（理論板高當量）= L / N
  L = 柱長（cm）
  N = 理論板數（由峰寬計算）

Asymmetry（不對稱因子）= b / a
  a = 從峰頂垂線到前峰半峰寬
  b = 從峰頂垂線到後峰半峰寬
  接受標準通常：0.8 ≤ Asymmetry ≤ 1.5

再生使用計數規則：
  Total use count = Normal runs + Reprocessing runs
  必須 ≤ Validated lifetime（已驗證生命週期）
blocks.en:
HETP (Height Equivalent to a Theoretical Plate) = L / N
  L = column length (cm)
  N = number of theoretical plates (calculated from peak width)

Asymmetry = b / a
  a = leading half-width of the peak (from the perpendicular through the peak apex to the front edge)
  b = trailing half-width of the peak (from the perpendicular through the peak apex to the rear edge)
  Typical acceptance criterion: 0.8 ≤ Asymmetry ≤ 1.5

Regeneration use-count rule:
  Total use count = Normal runs + Reprocessing runs
  Must be ≤ Validated lifetime

blocks.zh: Prospective vs Concurrent Validation（前瞻性 vs 同步驗證）：
Prospective（前瞻性）：事先設計、執行、取得數據後才放行。再處理頻率高時適用。本案例採用 1 批 GMP 規模確認批。
blocks.en: Prospective: Designed and executed in advance, with batches released only after the data are obtained. Suitable when reprocessing is frequent. This case uses one GMP-scale confirmation batch.

blocks.zh: Concurrent（同步）：允許在驗證執行期間放行批次，適用於再處理頻率極低、難以累積足夠批次的情境。接受標準必須對應已核准規格。
blocks.en: Concurrent: Allows batches to be released while the validation is being executed; suitable where reprocessing is very infrequent and it is hard to accumulate enough batches. The acceptance criteria must correspond to the approved specifications.

blocks.zh: 監管申報等級：FDA PAS（Prior Approval Supplement，事前核准補充申請）> CBE-30（Changes Being Effected，30 天通知）。透過 Comparability Protocol 預先取得 FDA 同意，可在驗證完成後改用 CBE-30，大幅縮短商業化時程。
blocks.en: Regulatory filing categories: FDA PAS (Prior Approval Supplement) > CBE-30 (Changes Being Effected, 30-day notification). By obtaining FDA agreement in advance through a Comparability Protocol, the filing can be downgraded to CBE-30 once validation is complete, greatly shortening the commercialization timeline.

blocks.zh: 6.2.5 的監管策略就像先向主管機關「預告」一個工程變更計畫：「我打算在特定條件下執行再處理，以下是我的驗證方案和接受標準，請提前審核並同意未來改用簡化申報程序。」這樣當再處理真正發生時，只需遞交 CBE-30（30 天通知），而不必等待 PAS 的 6–12 個月審查，避免產品斷貨。
blocks.en: The regulatory strategy in 6.2.5 is like giving the authority advance notice of an engineering change plan: "I intend to carry out reprocessing under specific conditions; here are my validation plan and acceptance criteria; please review them in advance and agree that a simplified filing route can be used in future." Then, when reprocessing really occurs, only a CBE-30 (30-day notification) needs to be submitted, instead of waiting 6–12 months for PAS review, which avoids product stock-outs.

blocks.zh: 若一根 AEX 樹脂的驗證壽命是 200 次，已正常使用 185 次，現在需要再處理 1 次，是否符合 6.2.4 的要求？如果需要第 2 次再處理呢？
blocks.en: If the validated lifetime of an AEX resin is 200 cycles and it has already been used normally 185 times, does one reprocessing run now meet the requirement of 6.2.4? What if a second reprocessing run is needed?

blocks.zh: 在 EMA 框架下，Type II Variation 與 Type IB Variation 的主要差異是什麼？Change Management Protocol 如何幫助降低申報等級？
blocks.en: Under the EMA framework, what is the main difference between a Type II Variation and a Type IB Variation? How does a Change Management Protocol help lower the filing category?

Content 申報內容
Reference to Specific Section 參照章節

3.2.S.2.6
（製程發展）
6.3 Scope of Reprocessing 再處理範疇
6.3.1 Determining the Need for Reprocessing 確定再處理的必要性
6.3.2 Business Case and Project Charter 商業案例與專案章程
FMEA（Failure Mode and Effects Analysis，失效模式與影響分析）：一種前瞻性的結構化風險評估工具，ICH Q9(R1) 推薦方法之一。三個評分維度：
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): A prospective, structured risk assessment tool and one of the methods recommended in ICH Q9(R1). It has three scoring dimensions:

blocks.zh: S — Severity（嚴重性）：評估失效對 CQA 的潛在影響程度（1/3/5 三級）
blocks.en: S — Severity: Assesses the potential impact of the failure on CQAs (three levels: 1/3/5)

blocks.zh: O — Occurrence（發生頻率）：評估失效模式的發生概率（1/3/5 三級）
blocks.en: O — Occurrence: Assesses the probability that the failure mode occurs (three levels: 1/3/5)

blocks.zh: D — Detection（可偵測性）：評估在步驟完成前能否及時偵測到失效（1/3/5 三級）
blocks.en: D — Detection: Assesses whether the failure can be detected in time before the step is completed (three levels: 1/3/5)

blocks.zh: RPN = S × O × D，範圍 1–125（本案例三個維度均為最高分 5）。
blocks.en: RPN = S × O × D, range 1–125 (in this case all three dimensions have the highest score of 5).

blocks.zh: IPC（In-Process Control，製程中管控）：本案例中 AEX eluate HCP 的 IPC 限度設定為 ≤80 ng/mg（action limit ≤100 ng/mg 的 80%），作為再處理觸發點的警戒值。
blocks.en: IPC (In-Process Control): In this case the IPC limit for AEX eluate HCP is set at ≤80 ng/mg (80% of the action limit of ≤100 ng/mg), serving as the alert value for the reprocessing trigger point.

blocks.zh: FMEA 評分就像汽車定期保養的風險檢查表：技師會為每個零件評估「壞了有多嚴重（S）」× 「多容易壞（O）」× 「壞了能不能及時發現（D）」= 整體風險分數。剎車片壞了很嚴重（S=5）、長期不換容易磨損（O=5）、但有警示燈可以偵測（D=1），RPN = 25；而 AEX 步驟的 HCP 問題：嚴重（S=5）× 偶爾發生（O=5）× 無法在步驟完成前即時偵測（D=5）= RPN 125，是所有步驟中最高的，因此被選為再處理候選步驟。
blocks.en: FMEA scoring is like the risk checklist for regular car maintenance: the technician evaluates each part for "how serious is it if it fails (S)" × "how easily does it fail (O)" × "if it fails, can it be detected in time (D)" = overall risk score. A failed brake pad is very serious (S=5), wears out easily if not replaced for a long time (O=5), but a warning light can detect it (D=1), so RPN = 25. By contrast, an HCP problem at the AEX step is serious (S=5) × occurs occasionally (O=5) × cannot be detected immediately before the step is completed (D=5) = RPN 125, the highest of all steps, so it was chosen as the reprocessing candidate step.

blocks.zh:
FMEA 評分邏輯（本案例）：

AEX 步驟 HCP 問題：
  S = 5（HCP 超標 → 直接影響 CQA）
  O = 5（每 <100 批中發生 1 次）
  D = 5（AEX eluate 無法在步驟完成前偵測 HCP）
  RPN = 5 × 5 × 5 = 125  ← 最高分，確認為候選步驟

對比：Protein A 步驟：
  S = 3, O = 1, D = 1 → RPN = 3（低風險）

對比：CEX 步驟：
  S = 5, O = 3, D = 1 → RPN = 15（中等風險）

IPC 觸發點設計：
  Action limit：HCP <100 ng/mg
  IPC alert limit：≤80 ng/mg（= action limit × 80%）
  → 80 ng/mg 超標 → 觸發再處理調查
blocks.en:
FMEA scoring logic (this case):

HCP problem at the AEX step:
  S = 5 (HCP out of limit → directly affects CQA)
  O = 5 (occurs once in every <100 batches)
  D = 5 (HCP in the AEX eluate cannot be detected before the step is completed)
  RPN = 5 × 5 × 5 = 125  ← highest score, confirmed as the candidate step

Comparison: Protein A step:
  S = 3, O = 1, D = 1 → RPN = 3 (low risk)

Comparison: CEX step:
  S = 5, O = 3, D = 1 → RPN = 15 (medium risk)

IPC trigger point design:
  Action limit: HCP <100 ng/mg
  IPC alert limit: ≤80 ng/mg (= action limit × 80%)
  → 80 ng/mg exceeded → triggers a reprocessing investigation

blocks.zh: D = 5（無法偵測）是 AEX 選為再處理步驟的關鍵：HCP 需要專門的分析方法（ELISA 或 LC-MS），無法在製程中即時監控，只能在步驟完成後採樣分析。這就是為什麼 D = 5，也是為什麼需要預先設計再處理方案，而不是等到問題發生再臨時應對。
blocks.en: D = 5 (cannot be detected) is the key reason AEX was chosen as the reprocessing step: HCP requires dedicated analytical methods (ELISA or LC-MS) and cannot be monitored in real time during the process; samples can only be taken and analyzed after the step is completed. This is why D = 5, and why the reprocessing plan must be designed in advance rather than improvised after a problem occurs.

blocks.zh: 三選項決策框架：品質（CQA 合規性）是所有選項的前提，在三個選項都能確保產品品質的情況下，Option 3（再處理）因成本最低且不需要製程重新開發，成為首選。決策層級：CQA → Business。
blocks.en: Three-option decision framework: Quality (CQA compliance) is the prerequisite for all options. When all three options can ensure product quality, Option 3 (reprocessing) becomes the first choice because it has the lowest cost and does not require process redevelopment. Decision hierarchy: CQA → Business.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，在與 Sponsor 或 DS CMO 進行技術轉移審查時，若 Sponsor 的 DS 製程包含 AEX 步驟，可以主動詢問：「是否已有再處理的 FMEA 評估？HCP 的 IPC alert limit 設定在何處？再處理觸發條件是否已寫入 BLA/MAA？」這展示了 CDMO 對上游製程的深度理解，有助於建立信任。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, during a tech transfer review with a Sponsor or DS CMO, if the Sponsor's DS process includes an AEX step, you can proactively ask: "Is there already an FMEA assessment for reprocessing? Where is the HCP IPC alert limit set? Have the reprocessing trigger conditions been written into the BLA/MAA?" This demonstrates the CDMO's deep understanding of the upstream process and helps build trust.

blocks.zh: 如果 Virus-Retentive Filtration 步驟的 RPN = 25（S=5, O=5, D=1），為什麼不選它作為再處理候選步驟？（提示：考慮 D 值的含義）
blocks.en: If the RPN of the Virus-Retentive Filtration step is 25 (S=5, O=5, D=1), why is it not chosen as the reprocessing candidate step? (Hint: consider what the D value means)

blocks.zh: 為什麼 IPC alert limit 要設定在 action limit 的 70–80%（如 80 ng/mg），而不是直接用 100 ng/mg 作為觸發點？
blocks.en: Why should the IPC alert limit be set at 70–80% of the action limit (e.g., 80 ng/mg) rather than using 100 ng/mg directly as the trigger point?

RPN (Risk Priority Number，風險優先數) = S × O × D，範圍 1–125。RPN 越高，優先級越高，越需要採取再處理或其他控制措施。
blocks.en: RPN (Risk Priority Number) = S × O × D, range 1–125. The higher the RPN, the higher the priority, and the greater the need for reprocessing or other control measures.

blocks.zh: 6.4 Quality Considerations 品質考量
6.4.1 Quality Attribute Impact Assessment 品質屬性影響評估
6.4.2 Analytical Methods 分析方法
6.4.3 Comparability Criteria 可比性標準
6.4.4 Monitor Triggers 監控觸發點
6.4.5 Investigate, Execute Protocols, Analyze Data, Document Results, and Complete Commitments 調查、執行方案、分析數據、記錄結果及履行承諾
blocks.en: 6.4.5 Investigate, Execute Protocols, Analyze Data, Document Results, and Complete Commitments

blocks.zh: 6.4.1 第二輪 FMEA（Example 2）— 評估再處理本身對 CQA 的影響：與 6.3.1 的 FMEA（評估哪個步驟需要再處理）不同，6.4.1 的 FMEA 專門評估「如果執行 AEX 再處理，每個品質屬性會受到什麼影響」。由於假設公司已有完整分析方法，D = 1（均可偵測）。
blocks.en: 6.4.1 Second-round FMEA (Example 2) — assessing the impact of reprocessing itself on CQAs: Unlike the FMEA in 6.3.1 (which assesses which step needs reprocessing), the FMEA in 6.4.1 specifically assesses "if AEX reprocessing is performed, how will each quality attribute be affected". Because the hypothetical company already has complete analytical methods, D = 1 (all attributes can be detected).

blocks.zh: RPN ≥ 15 的屬性需要進一步評估：包括 Protein concentration（蛋白質濃度）、Aggregate（聚集體）、Acidic variants（酸性異構體）、Fragmentation（碎片）、Potency（效力）、Oxidation（氧化）、HCP（宿主細胞蛋白）。這些屬性在 6.4.2 的分析方法中均需有對應檢測方法。
blocks.en: Attributes with RPN ≥ 15 require further evaluation: These include Protein concentration, Aggregate, Acidic variants, Fragmentation, Potency, Oxidation and HCP (host cell proteins). Each of these attributes needs a corresponding test method among the analytical methods in 6.4.2.

blocks.zh: Comparability Criteria（可比性標準）：再處理後的中間品品質屬性必須與未再處理的 AEX eluate 「一致（consistent）」，唯一例外是 HCP——預期 HCP 水平因再處理而降低（這正是再處理的目的）。
blocks.en: Comparability Criteria: The quality attributes of the reprocessed intermediate must be "consistent" with those of AEX eluate that has not been reprocessed. The only exception is HCP, which is expected to be lower as a result of reprocessing (this is precisely the purpose of reprocessing).

blocks.zh: 6.4.2 分析方法矩陣的深度：Table 6.4.2-1 涵蓋從聚集體（SEC、RP-HPLC、Fluorimetry）到糖基化（LC-MS、HPLC）的完整分析工具箱。非常規測試（nonroutine testing）需要在 AEX eluate 基質（matrix）中驗證（validated）或確認（qualified），不能直接借用 DS release 方法。
blocks.en: 6.4.2 Depth of the analytical methods matrix: Table 6.4.2-1 covers a complete analytical toolbox, from aggregates (SEC, RP-HPLC, Fluorimetry) to glycosylation (LC-MS, HPLC). Nonroutine testing must be validated or qualified in the AEX eluate matrix; DS release methods cannot simply be borrowed.

blocks.zh: 6.4.3 穩定性計畫：再處理的第一批 DS 必須納入已建立的實時穩定性（real-time stability）和加速穩定性（accelerated stability）方案。穩定性數據是後續 CBE-30/Type IB 提交的重要組成部分（見 Table 6.2.5-1，3.2.S.7）。
blocks.en: 6.4.3 Stability program: The first reprocessed DS batch must be included in the established real-time stability and accelerated stability programs. Stability data are an important component of the subsequent CBE-30/Type IB submission (see Table 6.2.5-1, 3.2.S.7).

blocks.zh: 6.4.4 監控觸發機制設計原則：Action limit（動作限度）<100 ng/mg，alert limit（警戒限度）≤80 ng/mg（20% 緩衝帶，用於考慮分析變異度和製程漂移）。觸發點必須明確寫入 SOP 和批次記錄，確保 GMP 可追溯性。
blocks.en: 6.4.4 Design principles for the monitoring trigger mechanism: Action limit <100 ng/mg, alert limit ≤80 ng/mg (a 20% buffer band, to allow for analytical variability and process drift). The trigger points must be clearly written into SOPs and batch records to ensure GMP traceability.

blocks.zh: 6.4.5 調查義務（CAPA）：每次觸發再處理都必須進行正式調查，記錄根本原因（root cause）、對產品品質的影響評估（quality impact assessment）和糾正預防措施（CAPA）。這是 GMP 合規的基本要求，不能省略。
blocks.en: 6.4.5 Obligation to investigate (CAPA): Every time reprocessing is triggered, a formal investigation must be performed, documenting the root cause, the quality impact assessment and the corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). This is a basic GMP compliance requirement and cannot be omitted.

blocks.zh: 6.4 的品質考量就像醫院的急救流程設計：在病人真正送達之前（= 再處理真正發生之前），醫院已預先設計好「哪些生命徵象需要監控（6.4.4）」、「哪些數值超標就啟動緊急程序（6.4.4 觸發點）」、「緊急手術的標準做法是什麼（6.4.5 執行方案）」、「手術後如何確認病人恢復正常（6.4.3 可比性標準）」。這種前瞻性設計讓真正的緊急事件發生時，每個人都知道該做什麼。
blocks.en: The quality considerations in 6.4 are like the design of a hospital emergency protocol: before the patient actually arrives (= before reprocessing actually occurs), the hospital has already designed in advance "which vital signs need to be monitored (6.4.4)", "which out-of-range values trigger the emergency procedure (6.4.4 trigger points)", "what is the standard approach for emergency surgery (6.4.5 execution of protocols)" and "how to confirm the patient has returned to normal after surgery (6.4.3 comparability criteria)". This forward-looking design means that when a real emergency occurs, everyone knows what to do.

blocks.zh:
6.4.1 FMEA Example 2 關鍵數字：
  所有屬性 D = 1（假設均可偵測）
  RPN ≥ 15 → 需進一步評估

  Leachables/Extractables：S=3, O=3, D=3 → RPN=27
  （是唯一 D≠1 的項目，因第二次接觸樹脂/過濾器）

  Buffer/Solution supply：S=5, O=5, D=1 → RPN=25
  Equipment cleaning：S=5, O=5, D=1 → RPN=25
  （兩者為操作層面的風險，非品質屬性風險）

HCP 監控觸發設計：
  Release spec：<12 ng/mg（DS 放行規格）
  Action limit：<100 ng/mg（AEX eluate IPC）
  Alert limit：≤80 ng/mg（= 100 × 80%）
  再處理觸發：HCP >100 ng/mg → 啟動調查 + 再處理方案
blocks.en:
6.4.1 FMEA Example 2 key figures:
  All attributes D = 1 (assumed detectable)
  RPN ≥ 15 → requires further evaluation

  Leachables/Extractables: S=3, O=3, D=3 → RPN=27
  (the only item with D≠1, because of a second contact with the resin/filters)

  Buffer/Solution supply: S=5, O=5, D=1 → RPN=25
  Equipment cleaning: S=5, O=5, D=1 → RPN=25
  (both are operational risks, not quality attribute risks)

HCP monitoring trigger design:
  Release spec: <12 ng/mg (DS release specification)
  Action limit: <100 ng/mg (AEX eluate IPC)
  Alert limit: ≤80 ng/mg (= 100 × 80%)
  Reprocessing trigger: HCP >100 ng/mg → start investigation + reprocessing plan

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 負責 DP 端（Fill-Finish），而 Sponsor 的 DS CMO 執行了 AEX 再處理，CDMO 需要確認：(1) Sponsor 已按 6.4.3 完成可比性評估，DS 放行規格全部符合；(2) Sponsor 提供了正式調查報告（根本原因 + CAPA）；(3) 穩定性計畫包含再處理批次。這些是 DS/DP 介面品質協議（Quality Agreement）中應明確規定的 Sponsor 義務。
blocks.en: If the CDMO is responsible for the DP side (Fill-Finish) and the Sponsor's DS CMO has performed AEX reprocessing, the CDMO needs to confirm that: (1) the Sponsor has completed the comparability assessment per 6.4.3 and all DS release specifications are met; (2) the Sponsor has provided a formal investigation report (root cause + CAPA); (3) the stability program includes the reprocessed batch. These are Sponsor obligations that should be clearly specified in the DS/DP interface Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: 在 6.4.1 的 FMEA 中，Leachables and Extractables 的 D 值為 3（非 1），這是什麼原因？在再處理設計中如何降低這個風險？
blocks.en: In the 6.4.1 FMEA, why is the D value for Leachables and Extractables 3 (not 1)? How can this risk be reduced in the reprocessing design?

blocks.zh: 6.4.3 說「HCP 預期會降低（expected to be reduced）」——這是再處理的預期效果。如果再處理後 HCP 反而升高，應如何解讀？這批批次可以放行嗎？
blocks.en: 6.4.3 states that HCP is "expected to be reduced", which is the intended effect of reprocessing. If HCP instead increases after reprocessing, how should this be interpreted? Can the batch be released?

blocks.zh: 6.4.5 要求每次再處理都要進行調查。調查應包含哪些必要元素，才能滿足 PIC/S GMP 的要求？
blocks.en: 6.4.5 requires an investigation for every reprocessing event. What essential elements should the investigation include to satisfy PIC/S GMP requirements?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary (Part A: 6.0–6.4)
6.0 框架定位：AEX 再處理案例是 TR74 最複雜的示範情境，刻意設計以涵蓋完整的再處理分析框架。品質管理系統、法規要求、製程理解是設計驅動力，商業考量排第三。
blocks.en: 6.0 Framework positioning: The AEX reprocessing case is the most complex demonstration scenario in TR74, deliberately designed to cover the complete reprocessing analysis framework. The quality management system, regulatory requirements and process understanding are the design drivers; business considerations rank third.

blocks.zh: 6.1 單元操作理解：AEX 以 flow-through 模式清除 HCP/DNA/病毒，mAb 直接通過。系統組件（buffer reservoirs、pumps、column、resin、valves、sensors、controller）共同確保層析系統的可靠性。
blocks.en: 6.1 Understanding the unit operation: AEX clears HCP/DNA/virus in flow-through mode, with the mAb passing straight through. The system components (buffer reservoirs, pumps, column, resin, valves, sensors, controller) together ensure the reliability of the chromatography system.

blocks.zh: 6.2 技術可行性評估五要點：柱填充完整性（6.2.1）→ 清洗/消毒（6.2.2）→ 性能測試（6.2.3）→ 樹脂壽命管理（6.2.4）→ 驗證與申報策略（6.2.5）。每個要點都是「再處理可以執行」的先決條件。
blocks.en: 6.2 Five points for technical feasibility assessment: Column packing integrity (6.2.1) → cleaning/sanitization (6.2.2) → performance testing (6.2.3) → resin lifetime management (6.2.4) → validation and filing strategy (6.2.5). Each point is a prerequisite for "reprocessing can be carried out".

blocks.zh: 6.3 FMEA Example 1（步驟層面）：AEX 步驟 RPN = 125（S=5, O=5, D=5），是所有純化步驟中唯一同時具有高嚴重性、高發生頻率、高不可偵測性的步驟，因此被確認為再處理候選步驟。三選項中，Option 3（再處理）在確保品質的前提下最具成本效益。
blocks.en: 6.3 FMEA Example 1 (step level): The AEX step has RPN = 125 (S=5, O=5, D=5) and is the only purification step with high severity, high occurrence and high non-detectability at the same time, so it was confirmed as the reprocessing candidate step. Among the three options, Option 3 (reprocessing) is the most cost-effective while ensuring quality.

blocks.zh: 6.4 FMEA Example 2（屬性層面）+ 品質把關機制：再處理對 Protein concentration、Aggregates、Acidic variants、Fragmentation、Potency、Oxidation、HCP 均可能有影響（RPN ≥ 15），需用 Table 6.4.2-1 的完整分析方法矩陣進行評估。可比性標準（6.4.3）、監控觸發點（6.4.4，HCP >100 ng/mg）和調查義務（6.4.5）形成完整的品質閉環。
blocks.en: 6.4 FMEA Example 2 (attribute level) + quality safeguard mechanisms: Reprocessing may affect Protein concentration, Aggregates, Acidic variants, Fragmentation, Potency, Oxidation and HCP (RPN ≥ 15), which must be evaluated using the full analytical methods matrix in Table 6.4.2-1. The comparability criteria (6.4.3), monitor triggers (6.4.4, HCP >100 ng/mg) and the obligation to investigate (6.4.5) together form a complete quality loop.

blocks.zh: 決策層級：CQA 合規性 → 業務可行性（Business Case）→ 操作執行（Project Charter）。品質永遠是第一道關卡。
blocks.en: Decision hierarchy: CQA compliance → business feasibility (Business Case) → operational execution (Project Charter). Quality is always the first gate.
